# Storage API

21 endpoints. Request and response schemas are described on the [schemas page](schemas.md); the other tags are listed in the [API index](README.md).

## Endpoints

### `GET /api/v1/admin/recovery/status`

Disaster-recovery journal status

State of the row journal behind `openartifact rebuild`: how many changed package rows still wait for their sidecar blob, how old the oldest is, the last failure and the progress of the backfill reconcile (admin only)

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Journal status | `application/json`: [RecoveryStatus](schemas.md#recoverystatus) |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |

### `POST /api/v1/admin/storage`

Create storage backend

### `GET /api/v1/admin/storage/replication`

Blob replication status

Backlog, lag, totals and the last verify pass of the replication to storage.replica (admin only). Reports enabled=false when no replica is configured. This static path takes precedence over /admin/storage/{name}.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Replication status | `application/json`: [ReplicationStatus](schemas.md#replicationstatus) |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |

### `POST /api/v1/admin/storage/replication/verify`

Verify the replica now

Requests a verify pass that compares the primary store with the replica and repairs differences in either direction; it runs in the background on the replica holding the verify lock (admin only)

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `202` | Pass requested | `application/json`: object |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |
| `404` | Blob replication is not configured | - |
| `409` | A verify pass is already running or requested | - |

Fields of the `202` response (`application/json`):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `requested` | boolean | no | - |

### `PATCH /api/v1/admin/storage/{name}`

Update storage backend

Update a storage backend (admin only). Changing kind or config is refused with 409 while the backend holds blobs, serves a tier or is named by a tier move

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config` | object | no | - |
| `is_default` | boolean | no | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Storage backend updated | `application/json`: [StorageBackend](schemas.md#storagebackend) |
| `404` | Storage backend not found | - |
| `409` | The kind or config cannot change while the backend holds blobs, serves a tier or is named by a tier move | - |

### `POST /api/v1/admin/tiering/dry-run`

Simulate storage policies

Reports what a mover pass would move now (counts, bytes, per route and policy, and a sample) without changing anything. With policy set only that draft is simulated; otherwise every enabled policy and promote-on-read are (admin only)

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `policy` | [StoragePolicyInput](schemas.md#storagepolicyinput) | no | - |
| `sample_limit` | integer | no | Between 0 and 200; default 200. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Simulation result | `application/json`: [TierDryRun](schemas.md#tierdryrun) |
| `400` | Invalid request | - |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |

### `POST /api/v1/admin/tiering/tiers`

Create storage tier

Maps an existing storage backend to a named tier (admin only)

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `backend` | string | yes | Name of an existing storage backend. |
| `name` | string | yes | - |
| `promote_on_read` | boolean | no | - |
| `rank` | integer | no | Position from hot (low) to cold (high); defaults to after the last tier. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Tier created | `application/json`: [StorageTier](schemas.md#storagetier) |
| `400` | Invalid request | - |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |
| `409` | Name or backend already used by a tier | - |

### `DELETE /api/v1/admin/tiering/tiers/{name}`

Delete storage tier

Deletes a tier that holds no blobs and is not referenced by a policy; the primary tier cannot be deleted (admin only)

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | Tier deleted | - |
| `400` | The primary tier cannot be deleted | - |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |
| `404` | Storage tier not found | - |
| `409` | Tier still holds blobs, has moves in progress or is used by a policy | - |
